coverage.value: "Continental Baptist Missions" church planting mission agency official website

Continental Baptist Missions — real domain is gocbm.org (NOT cbmin.org, which is Canadian Baptist Ministries, and not cbmissions.org or continentalbaptistmissions.org). Rockford MI, incorporated 1942, independent Baptist, North America only (church planting, revitalization, church building).
gocbm.org missionaries church planters support (allowed_domains gocbm.org)
gocbm.org missionary family "and" church planter profile page (allowed_domains gocbm.org)
"gocbm.org" missionary "Benton" OR "Brown" OR "support" page

gocbm.org — NOT A HIT. Surface is a single flat roster at gocbm.org/about/missionaries plus gocbm.org/about/staff, with the only other person-adjacent paths being church pages keyed by CHURCH NAME (gocbm.org/churches/grace-baptist-church-2) and PDF newsletters (gocbm.org/resources/CBM-Contact-Summer-2020.pdf). No /missionary/<name> or /missionaries/<first>-and-<first>-<surname> slug exists in the index across three probes. Same failure mode as bcpm.org: keyed by church plant, not by person. Individual names (e.g. two couples) leak only through blog posts and newsletter PDFs, never through a person page. Record as DEAD for slug enumeration; worth one fetch pass on /about/missionaries if page fetching is ever enabled, since the roster is HTML and does name people.
bcpusa.org Baptist Church Planters missionaries (allowed_domains bcpusa.org)

Baptist Church Planters — HIT, and a double one. Confirmed DISTINCT from Baptist Church Planting Ministry (bcpm.org), which is recorded dead. Two independent per-person surfaces: (1) give.bcpusa.org/missionary/<first>-and-<first>-<surname> — clean readable couple slugs carrying the giving ask; (2) bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/<slug>/ — a WordPress person CPT, archive paginated to 5 pages (bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/page/2/ … /page/5/). The wpfc_person archive uses MIXED slug shapes on the same domain: named slugs (sheryl-ridley, michael-peck, chip-wood, orlando-and-debbie-collazo) and opaque numeric IDs (/4665/, /2283/, /3578/, /8470/) — graded per record, not per domain. Third surface: bcpusa.org/ministry-partners/ is a full alphabetical roster giving name, city/state and role, and it explicitly marks Retired entries.

Independent Faith Mission ifmmissions.org missionaries

Independent Faith Mission — the brief's domain ifmmissions.org is WRONG. Real domain is ifmnews.com (PO Box 7791, Greensboro NC; info@ifmnews.com). Independent Baptist sending agency, church planting and evangelism, home and abroad.
ifmnews.com missionaries support field (allowed_domains ifmnews.com)

ifmnews.com — NOT A HIT on this budget. Surface is a flat site-builder layout of top-level pages: /missionaries, /home-office-staff, /our-mission, /missionary-travel-network, /news-briefs, /available, /opportunities, /online-banking. No second path segment under /missionaries and no per-person slug appears anywhere in the index. The org is clearly a deputation/furlough faith mission (its Receipting Department and Financial Director exist to disperse donated funds into each missionary's account, and it runs a housing network for missionaries on deputation), so the PEOPLE are Tier A if they can be reached — but this surface does not expose them to search. Record the roster URL https://www.ifmnews.com/missionaries for a fetch pass; likely JS-rendered, which would explain zero person slugs in the index.

needs_review.issue: Retired missionaries named on the BCP roster — not emitted as prospects
needs_review.finding: bcpusa.org/ministry-partners/ explicitly marks these entries Retired: Bob Bennett (Berea OH), Donald and Linda Chilson (Williston FL), Ron and Sandra Cornell (Sebring FL, retired builder), Lois Gardner (Benton Harbor MI), and Jim/James and Sharon Solomon (Worthington WV, page bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/2283/).
needs_review.evidence: https://bcpusa.org/ministry-partners/ ; https://bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/2283/ ; give.bcpusa.org states '$100 provides spiritual support for retired missionaries', confirming retirees are supported BY the fund rather than raising their own.
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit as Tier A sales prospects. A retiree is not actively support-raising, and the roster's own Retired flag is authoritative. Hold for a reviewer decision on whether retired-status rows belong in the CRM at all; if they do, they belong in a separate segment.

needs_review.issue: BCP's wpfc_person archive mixes support-raised missionaries with unpaid council/board members
needs_review.finding: bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/david-whipple/ is titled 'David Whipple' but the snippet describes 'the first layman to serve on the Council, elected in 2002, serving as chairman on both the finance and building committees' — a governance volunteer, not a missionary.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted. Flag for the next wave: the wpfc_person CPT is NOT a clean missionary list. Any future mining of bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/page/2..5/ must read each title/snippet for council-member language before emitting, or the segment will fill with unpaid board volunteers graded Tier A.

needs_review.issue: Continental Baptist Missions people visible only in newsletter and blog prose, with no citable person page
needs_review.finding: Two CBM couples surfaced by name in search snippets — one described as having joined the CBM family, another described as CBM church planters of 35 years' standing — but every URL returned was a blog post, a newsletter PDF, or the flat /about/missionaries roster. No page belongs to either couple.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted — citing a blog post or a newsletter PDF as a person's page would fail the self-check. If page fetching is ever enabled, fetch https://gocbm.org/about/missionaries first; it is server-rendered HTML and is the only place CBM lists its people in one view.

needs_review.issue: Second-surface pages found for people already emitted from their giving page — do not double-ingest
needs_review.finding: Several BCP people have BOTH a give.bcpusa.org/missionary/<slug> giving page and a bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/<slug-or-id>/ profile: Stevenson (/wpfc_person/jimmy-stevenson/), Owen (/wpfc_person/scott-marti-owen/), Weeks (/wpfc_person/3578/), Wilmeth (/wpfc_person/eric-wilmeth/), Peck (/wpfc_person/michael-peck/).
needs_review.evidence: Both URL sets appeared in the same result pages during mining.
needs_review.recommendation: For these I cited the give.bcpusa.org page, because it carries the actual support ask and has a readable named slug. Deduplicate on person-name plus org at ingest, not on source_url, or these will land twice.

needs_review.issue: BCP wpfc_person archive is only partly enumerated and page 8470 is bot-blocked
needs_review.finding: The archive runs to 5 pages (bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/page/2/ … /page/5/) and search surfaced only a fraction of it. One member page, bcpusa.org/wpfc_person/8470/, returned the title 'Client Challenge' — an Akamai-style bot interstitial rather than the person's name.
needs_review.recommendation: BCP is not exhausted — it ran out of BUDGET, not of people. A follow-up agent with a fresh 18 searches should walk /wpfc_person/page/2/ through /page/5/ with state and role qualifiers (the roster spans NE, OH, PA, NY, FL, MI, SC, MO, WV at minimum). Note the bot interstitial: some numeric-ID pages will not yield a title to search, so those people are reachable only by fetch.
